description: This source file defines the PrometheusServiceClient class which is used as an SDK client to interact with the Amazon Prometheus Service. It includes method annotations for various asynchronous and synchronous API calls corresponding to different Prometheus Service operations.

classes.name: PrometheusServiceClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient to provide methods specific to the Amazon Prometheus Service API.

methods.name: createAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Creates an Alert Manager definition with provided arguments.

methods.name: createAlertManagerDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an Alert Manager definition with provided arguments.

methods.name: createLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a logging configuration for the service.

methods.name: createRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a namespace for rule groups.

methods.name: deleteAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Deletes an existing Alert Manager definition.

methods.name: describeAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves details about an Alert Manager definition.

methods.name: describeAlertManagerDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous retrieval of Alert Manager definition details.

methods.name: describeRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Provides details about a rule groups namespace.

methods.name: describeRuleGroupsNamespaceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous call to describe rule groups namespace.

methods.name: describeScraper
methods.description: Provides details about a specific scraper.

methods.name: describeScraperAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous call to describe a scraper.

methods.name: getDefaultScraperConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the default configuration for scrapers.

methods.name: listRuleGroupsNamespacesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of rule groups namespaces.

methods.name: putAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates an Alert Manager definition.

methods.name: putRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Creates or updates a rule groups namespace.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous addition of tags to a resource.
